long_biography.plain_text:
Bringing Hilton back to Mexico after more than two decades was an early expression of Carlos Gerardo Ancira Elizondo's partnership-led approach to hotel development. Grupo Chartwell adapted office space at Mexico City's airport for the project, then acquired a Krystal hotel portfolio and joined Goldman Sachs in the purchase of Quinta Real.

Ancira initiated Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe as an integrated owner, developer and operator. The listed company works across its Krystal brand and international franchises, combining owned properties with management contracts for third parties. He remains chairman, leads the executive committee and holds a substantial stake through direct and corporate ownership. Ancira studied public accounting at Universidad Anáhuac.
